topic: Describe a famous person you admire. Explain why you admire them and what impact they have had.

en.admire: to respect and approve of someone or something
en.impact: a powerful effect that someone or something has on a situation or person
en.achieve: to succeed in getting a good result or in reaching your aims
en.inspire: to make someone feel that they want to do something and can do it
en.contribution: something that you do that helps to achieve or make something
en.career: the job or series of jobs that you do during your working life
en.talent: a natural ability to do something well
en.influence: the power to affect how someone thinks or behaves, or how something develops

en.hobby: an activity that someone does for pleasure when they are not working
en.important: having a great effect on people or things
en.relax: to become happy and calm because of not being worried about anything
en.creative: involving the use of skill and imagination to produce something new
en.improve: to become better, or to make something better
en.skill: an ability to do an activity or job well, especially because you have practised it

en.satisfaction: a pleasant feeling that you get when you receive something you wanted, or when you have achieved something

topic: Describe your favourite season of the year. What do you enjoy doing during this season?

en.season: one of the four periods into which the year is divided according to the weather
en.weather: the conditions in the air above the earth such as wind, rain, or temperature
en.temperature: the measure of how hot or cold something is
en.activity: something that you do, often as opposed to thinking
en.outside: near or next to a building, usually without a roof
en.comfortable: providing a pleasant feeling and not causing any pain
en.atmosphere: the air or feeling of a place

en.importance: the state or fact of being important
en.future: a period of time that will happen after the present
en.communicate: to share information with others by speaking, writing, or using other methods
en.opportunity: a situation in which it is possible for you to do something, or a possibility of doing something
en.travel: to make a journey, usually over a long distance

en.career: the job or series of jobs that you do during your working life
en.understand: to know the meaning of something that someone says or does

topic: Describe your ideal holiday. Where would you go and what would you do?

en.holiday: a time when someone does not work and can relax or travel
en.destination: the place where someone is going or where something is being sent or taken
en.relax: to become happy and calm because of not being worried about anything
en.adventure: an unusual, exciting, and possibly dangerous activity
en.culture: the way of life, especially the general customs and beliefs, of a particular group of people at a particular time
en.sightseeing: the activity of visiting interesting places, especially by people on holiday
en.delicious: having a very pleasant taste or smell
en.memory: something that you remember from the past

topic: Talk about a film you have seen recently. What was it about and did you enjoy it?

en.film: a story shown in moving pictures
en.character: a person or animal in a book, play, or film
en.plot: the story of a book, film, play, etc.

topic: Describe your hometown or the place where you currently live. What do you like and dislike about it?

en.hometown: the town or city where you were born or lived when you were young

en.like: to find someone or something pleasant or attractive
en.dislike: to not like someone or something

en.facilities: buildings, equipment, or services that are provided for a particular purpose
en.transport: vehicles, systems, etc. for getting people or goods from one place to another
en.convenient: suitable for your purposes and not causing difficulty
